text:
Seedance 2.0 Disaster scene prompt

The Silent Retreat Uproar. 
Shot 1 (0.0-0.5): Macro shot of a mosquito landing on the Guru's nose during deep meditation. Audio: High pitched BZZZ. 
Shot 2 : The Guru's eye twitches violently. Audio: Spring boing. 
Shot 3 : He wildly slaps his own face, losing his balance. Audio: Sharp SMACK. 
Shot 4 : He tips sideways off his elevated lotus cushion. Audio: Slide whistle. 
Shot 5 : He crashes into a massive, 5-foot brass gong. Audio: Deafening GONG crash. 
Shot 6 : The soundwave startles the aerial yoga class hanging from silk hammocks. Audio: Gasps. 
Shot 7 : One student tangles in her silk, swinging wildly like a pendulum. Audio: Swish-swish. Shot 8 : She kicks a tray of burning incense into the air. Audio: Whoosh. 
Shot 9 : Hot ash lands directly on a therapy goat. Audio: Maaaa! 
Shot 10 : The goat charges, headbutting the bamboo room divider. Audio: THUD. 
Shot 11 : The divider collapses onto the crystal bowl sound healers. Audio: Cacophony of ringing crystal. 
Shot 12 : A vegan smoothie stand is knocked over by fleeing attendees. Audio: Splat! 
Shot 13 : Green sludge covers the entrance doors. Audio: Squish. 
Shot 14 : The Guru slips on the sludge, sliding right out the door. Audio: Cartoon slip. 
Shot 15 : Freeze frame of the Guru mid-air, covered in green smoothie, a goat chewing his robes. Audio: Camera shutter CLICK. Narrator: 'Yep. That is me. Finding my inner peace.'
content:
Structure your Seedance 2.0 prompt as a numbered multi-shot storyboard with explicit timestamps per shot (e.g., Shot 1 (0.0–0.5)) to control pacing  
Specify camera framing per shot (e.g., macro shot) to lock in composition changes across the sequence  
Add per-shot audio/SFX cues (e.g., High pitched BZZZ, SMACK, GONG crash) directly in the prompt to guide sound design and comedic timing  
Include a final freeze-frame shot with a specific audio cue (camera shutter CLICK) and a narrator line to create a punchline ending

translations.es:
Estructura tu prompt de Seedance 2.0 como un guion gráfico numerado de múltiples tomas con marcas de tiempo explícitas por toma (por ejemplo, Toma 1 (0.0–0.5)) para controlar el ritmo  
Especifica el encuadre de cámara por toma (por ejemplo, macro shot) para fijar los cambios de composición a lo largo de la secuencia  
Añade indicaciones de audio/SFX por toma (por ejemplo, High pitched BZZZ, SMACK, GONG crash) directamente en el prompt para guiar el diseño de sonido y el tiempo cómico  
Incluye una toma final en freeze-frame con una indicación de audio específica (camera shutter CLICK) y una línea del narrador para crear un final con remate
translations.fr:
Structurez votre prompt Seedance 2.0 comme un storyboard multi-shot numéroté avec des horodatages explicites par plan (par exemple, Shot 1 (0.0–0.5)) pour contrôler le rythme  
Spécifiez le cadrage de la caméra par plan (par exemple, macro shot) pour verrouiller les changements de composition tout au long de la séquence  
Ajoutez des indices audio/SFX par plan (par exemple, High pitched BZZZ, SMACK, GONG crash) directement dans le prompt pour guider la conception sonore et le timing comique  
Incluez un plan final en freeze-frame avec un indice audio spécifique (camera shutter CLICK) et une ligne de narrateur pour créer une fin percutante
translations.ja:
---
Seedance 2.0のプロンプトを、各ショットに明確なタイムスタンプを付けた番号付きのマルチショットストーリーボードとして構成してください（例：Shot 1 (0.0–0.5)）。これによりペースをコントロールします。  
各ショットごとにカメラのフレーミングを指定し（例：マクロショット）、シーケンス全体での構図の変化を固定します。  
各ショットごとにオーディオ/SFXのキュー（例：High pitched BZZZ, SMACK, GONG crash）をプロンプトに直接追加し、サウンドデザインとコメディのタイミングをガイドします。  
特定のオーディオキュー（カメラシャッターCLICK）とナレーターのセリフを含む最終的なフリーズフレームショットを追加し、パンチラインのエンディングを作成します。  
---
translations.ko:
---
Seedance 2.0 프롬프트를 번호가 매겨진 멀티샷 스토리보드로 구성하고, 각 샷에 명시적인 타임스탬프를 지정하여 페이싱을 제어하세요 (예: Shot 1 (0.0–0.5))  
각 샷에 카메라 프레이밍을 지정하여 (예: 매크로 샷) 시퀀스 전반에 걸친 구성 변화를 고정하세요  
샷별 오디오/SFX 큐를 프롬프트에 직접 추가하여 (예: High pitched BZZZ, SMACK, GONG crash) 사운드 디자인과 코믹 타이밍을 안내하세요  
특정 오디오 큐(카메라 셔터 CLICK)와 내레이터 라인을 포함한 최종 프리즈 프레임 샷을 포함하여 펀치라인 엔딩을 만드세요  
---
translations.pt-BR:
Estruture seu prompt Seedance 2.0 como um storyboard numerado de múltiplas cenas com timestamps explícitos por cena (por exemplo, Cena 1 (0.0–0.5)) para controlar o ritmo  
Especifique o enquadramento da câmera por cena (por exemplo, macro shot) para fixar mudanças de composição ao longo da sequência  
Adicione dicas de áudio/SFX por cena (por exemplo, High pitched BZZZ, SMACK, GONG crash) diretamente no prompt para guiar o design de som e o timing cômico  
Inclua uma cena final de freeze-frame com uma dica de áudio específica (camera shutter CLICK) e uma linha do narrador para criar um final com punchline
translations.zh-CN:
将您的Seedance 2.0 prompt 结构化为一个编号的多镜头分镜表，并为每个镜头指定明确的时间戳（例如，Shot 1 (0.0–0.5)）以控制节奏  
为每个镜头指定相机构图（例如，macro shot）以锁定整个序列中的构图变化  
在prompt中直接添加每个镜头的音频/SFX提示（例如，High pitched BZZZ, SMACK, GONG crash）以指导声音设计和喜剧节奏  
包含一个带有特定音频提示（camera shutter CLICK）的最终定格镜头，并加入旁白台词以创造一个笑点结尾
